bio_en: Barsegh Melik-Grigorian, known as Gharamelik, was one of the few veterans who had seen the dawn of the Armenian revolt. In the early 1880s, before any Armenian political party existed, he crossed into Ottoman Armenia as a young revolutionary propagandist, and his name soon became popular in the Karin (Erzurum) region. He witnessed the first massacre in Karin and wrote one of the earliest Armenian revolutionary publications about it. He later returned to the Caucasus and continued his work, and he died in Tiflis on 6 May 1915.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Pictured among 'the first couriers' with Hayk-Melik Dadayan and Bagrat vardapet Tavakalian.
